name: Element 52, Auberge Collection
positioning: Private two-to-five-bedroom residences in Telluride, Colorado, with direct access to the Telluride Ski Resort slopes
best_for: Groups and families who want a full kitchen and living space
Skiers who want direct access to the slopes

facts.text: Element 52 is at 398 South Davis Street along the San Miguel River in Telluride, Colorado.
The property is within walking distance of historic downtown Telluride and has direct access to the slopes of Telluride Ski Resort.
Residences have two to five bedrooms, spacious living areas and full kitchens.
The property has two heated outdoor soaking pools, a private spa and a fitness center.
Complimentary coffee, teas, hot cocoa, sodas, evening s'mores kits and wine or beer are available in the lobby.
Element 52 is approximately 15 minutes from Telluride Regional Airport.
A limited number of residences are pet-friendly.
The resort fee includes house car service throughout the town of Telluride.

highlights.text: A private funicular connects guests to the slopes, alongside an on-site ski valet, rentals and ski storage.
Pre-arrival grocery service, private chefs and local transportation can be arranged.
The property has two heated outdoor soaking pools, a private spa and a fitness center.

considerations.text: There is no restaurant on the property.
The residences have heating in winter but no air conditioning.
The resort fee is $40 per bedroom per night plus tax.
